name: Project and Organization Memory Boundaries
description: Memory is scoped to projects and organizations. Boundaries are enforced at the service layer. A project's memories are not visible from another project unless explicitly shared.
purpose: Ensure organizational data hygiene by enforcing memory boundaries between projects and organizations at the service layer, preventing data leakage and ensuring correct scoping of all memory operations.
acceptanceCriteria: Memory banks are scoped to a project and organization
Service-layer boundaries prevent cross-project memory access
All memory operations verify project and organization scope
Boundary violations are logged and rejected with clear error
rollback_strategy: Restore default scoping rules; revoke all cross-scope grants
recovery_strategy: Rebuild scoping assignments from project membership data
